You organize the unloading of the goods, sort them and store them properly in previously planned places. You make sure that the goods are stored under optimal conditions. You put together deliveries, pack the goods and make accompanying documents such as delivery notes or customs declarations. You also load trucks, serve forklift trucks and cranes, and secure the cargo against slipping.
